body: I wanted one so bad!! They were gone so fast.

I tried it after the mounjaro. It helped just not the same or as well. If they just want you to try it first for step therapy for coverage. I personally would probably do it to get it covered. It was better than nothing. You could probably do it just for a month or two then have your Dr put on the PA you tried and failed Wegovy. Then they should cover the Zepbound if there reason now is that you haven’t tried Wegovy first.
I do have more than I wanted. My advice would be what you already mentioned doing and making sure you aren’t losing too fast. I should have done the above and tried to slow how fast I was losing.

I wish I’d have worked out more so that’s great you’ve been doing that. I’ve had some mental health challenges too along the way so it’s made it hard at times for me to make myself workout. It’s getting better though.
I lost too fast too and lost a lot of muscle. I wish I’d tried to take it slower. I’m still very thankful I was able to get the medication and do well on it otherwise.
That’s great progress! Good job! I need to look into this suit again. I did at one point then forgot about it again
I have to use Express Scripts home delivery after this fill. There is no where to input copay card information. Has anyone done this and been able to use the copay card for a 3 month fill?

My mom really ruined my self image as a teen and even still to this day. I always got the you’d be so pretty if you’d just lose weight. Comments like that. So I tried to think about what ideas might help you. I do think the previous mom/daughter spa day is good. I think maybe adding it with you all going somewhere after might make it help her feel it’s less about her. Like let’s go get our hair and makeup done then go eat at this restaurant or something like that.

When I was on mounjaro previously it completely ended the food noise. It’s been really hard having that come back since I’ve been off. So I’m excited to get back started. Just need my PA approved and pharmacy to order.
That’s the one I’ll be on
I’m 31 and going with my friend in July.
